source.quote: Geshelli Labs' own page for the JNOG3 [J3], read 2026-11-25. Converter rows: « DAC Chip * AK4499 »; « AKM4499/AKM4191 Chipset »; « TI DIX9211 SPDIF DIR Chip ». Inputs: « 24bit SPDIF PCM Interface up to 216Khz »; « 4 Independently Selectable Ports Available (2xTOSLINK, 2xCOAX) Front and Rear ». Optional Amanero USB board: « 32Bit PCM (44.1Khz to 768Khz) »; « DSD64 - DSD512 Compatible ». Measurements under « Outputs »: « THD+N < .000300% »; « SINAD < 111dB »; « SNR < 121dB ». No filter, oversampling or NOS row. Native DSD versus DoP is not stated.

facts.chip: « AKM4499/AKM4191 Chipset » - the AK4191 digital front end feeding an AK4499, the same pairing SPL, Aurender and Cayin use. « TI DIX9211 » is the S/PDIF receiver, not the converter.

_DEUX_CENT_SEIZE_KILOHERTZ_est_un_chiffr: « 24bit SPDIF PCM Interface up to 216Khz ». Not 192, not 384: 216 kHz, which is no multiple of 44.1 or 48 and corresponds to no standard rate. It is the DIX9211 receiver's rated ceiling rather than a rate anyone sends, and the maker has published the part's limit where every other maker publishes the highest STANDARD rate below it. Recorded as printed, with this note, because a consumer reading 216000 and trying to send it will fail.
